Author: Serpens66
Name: Cheat Mod
Description: Provides optional host-controlled cheats for Stronghold Crusader Definitive Edition.

Changes: Updated the mod for Script Extender 2.2.0.
Add the shared Mod Settings search with title, optional tooltip and section filtering, safe global-search handoff, and automatic text-field focus.
Generate Portable PDB debug symbols for Unity Mono-compatible stack traces and debugging.
Adds standalone support for the shared Script Extender per-player identity workaround.
Run the mana tick updater only while Vanilla Extreme Powers are enabled, and react immediately when the Script Extender activation setter is used.
Added the host-controlled Endless Extreme Powers option, which refills every living human player's Extreme Powers mana once per 40 simulation ticks.
